title: Consulting engagement redesigns talent acquisition to scale at a multinational manufacturer.
summary: A multinational manufacturer partners to redesign its talent acquisition, establishing a scalable, data-driven framework for effective hiring and reduced costs.
body_markdown:
**Company/Industry**


A multinational manufacturer.


**Challenge**


With no formal talent acquisition (TA) process, roles were unclear, operating models were undefined, and performance was unmeasured — limiting recruitment scale and cost-efficiency.


**Solution**


A KellyOCG® consulting engagement covering current-state diagnostics, a future-state operating model, competency frameworks, and an offshore strategy for recruitment processes.


**Result**


A TA function that can scale: capability now measurable against industry benchmarks, hiring capacity sized to demand, role standards set, and a roadmap to lower recruitment spend.


## **Challenge: building a TA function from the ground up.**


A multinational manufacturer had no formal talent acquisition (TA) structure: Roles, operating models, and performance measures were all undefined. To build a recruitment capability that could scale affordably, they needed a partner to design a custom TA operating model.


That meant starting with a current-state assessment benchmarked against best practice, then building frameworks for roles, competencies, and offshoring — all while reducing recruitment spend.


## **Solution: organizational design through consulting engagement.**


Through our advisory services, KellyOCG reimagined the client's TA organization. Working closely with HR and business leaders, our team combined data analysis, HR survey reviews, and industry benchmarking to map where TA stood — and to build an actionable blueprint for where it needed to go.


### **Key elements of the engagement:**


## **Result: a blueprint for scalable, future-ready talent acquisition.**


The company now has a foundation for scalable hiring, better-quality hires, and leaner resourcing in a competitive talent market — grounded in data, benchmarked against industry standards, and built to grow.
